codeReview.summary: Generation-aware stale-event filtering and lifecycle tree clearing are implemented, but a blocking recovery regression was introduced for error-state panels/widgets.

issues.description: Error-state recovery can now close live views: `set_error` clears `tree` (e.g. lines 477-479 and 1932-1934), but `RenderDelta` handling closes the remote view when no tree is present (line 1262+). `gpui_plugin` continues to emit `RenderDelta` after initial render whenever dirty (`collect_messages` at `crates/gpui_plugin/src/gpui_plugin.rs:293-303`), so a plugin that reports an error and then rerenders can be force-closed instead of recovering.

summary: Reviewed transcript skeleton, skill usage, and commit 59c17f2813effc65f9c1160780e41a16be6fce60. The feature mostly matches lifecycle hardening goals, but introduced a blocking error-recovery regression where post-error rerenders can close the remote view.
